fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM58,325. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0056491/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Passed SPM/equivalent, with Credit in Malay, English, Mathematics, one Science subject (Biology / Physics / Chemistry / General Science / Applied Science), and one (1) other subject; OR GCE O-Level or equivalent, with Grade C in English, Mathematics, one (1) Science subject (Biology / Physics / Chemistry / General Science / Applied Science), and two (2) other subjects; OR Passed Certificate (MQF Level 3) related to Health Sciences, with 2.75 CGPA; OR Polytechnic Certificate (MQF Level 3) in related fields, with 2.00 CGPA; OR Passed Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia (SKM) Level 3 in related fields, and passed SPM with one (1) Credit; OR Passed MARA Skills Institute Certificate (MQF Level 3) in related fields, with 2.00 CGPA; OR Passed Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with Grade B in three (3) subjects; OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
